sources.name: European Central Bank euro reference rates (via Frankfurter API)
sources.coverage: Daily since 1999-01-04; stored as monthly averages + latest daily
sources.notes: Cross rates between non-euro currencies are computed through the euro.

sources.name: World Bank World Development Indicators (API v2)
sources.coverage: Annual, 1999–2026; FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG, NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS, BN.CAB.XOKA.GD.ZS, FI.RES.TOTL.MO, FR.INR.RINR, PA.NUS.PRVT.PP, PA.NUS.FCRF
sources.notes: Price level ratio = PA.NUS.PRVT.PP ÷ PA.NUS.FCRF (derived; PA.NUS.PPPC.RF is archived). France data shown for the euro. WB last updated: 2026-10-08

sources.name: The Economist Big Mac Index
sources.coverage: Semi-annual since 2000; euro area used for Paris
sources.notes: India uses the Maharaja Mac (chicken) in the Economist data.

sources.name: Bank for International Settlements central bank policy rates (WS_CBPOL)
sources.coverage: Monthly, end of period, since 1999; euro area for Paris
sources.notes: Real policy rate = annual average policy rate − CPI inflation (derived).
